nodes.name: Webhook: story MR merged by Edward

parameters.command: =glab issue update {{ $json.body.story_id }} --label-add 'merged-to-release' && glab issue close {{ $json.body.story_id }} --message 'Merged by Edward on {{ new Date().toISOString() }}. Story complete.'

=echo 'Close all child task tickets for story {{ $json.body.story_id }}' && glab issue list --label 'type:task' --milestone '{{ $json.body.version }}' | grep 'GL-{{ $json.body.story_id }}' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -I{} glab issue close {} --label-add released
=glab issue comment {{ $json.body.release_ticket_id }} --message 'Story GL-{{ $json.body.story_id }} merged to release. Deployment log entry: {{ new Date().toISOString() }}'

nodes.name: Sleep QA cluster for this story (F-27)
Notify Edward: all stories merged, ready for /uat
